hero.lede: Filming, scripting and editing vertical video for fashion, beauty, events and social media.

sobre.title: about me
story: at 16 I started Spencive, my own fashion brand. I ran everything, from marketing to operations, and that is where I learned to edit: every video had to introduce the brand and sell.
in 3 months, Spencive reached a 70% return on investment. owning a business that early taught me to meet deadlines, to answer for results and to treat every project as if it were mine.
today I'm a videomaker in Guarujá, Brazil. I script, shoot and edit vertical video for fashion brands, events and festivals, from brief to post.
